description: Implementation of the ProductImageService interface handling CRUD operations and image management for product images in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ProductImageServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation managing product images, including adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting product images with associated content and descriptions.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductImage by its ID.

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Adds multiple product images to a product, processing input streams and saving images and their metadata.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a single product image, uploading content and associating it with a product.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product image or updates an existing one, including handling descriptions.

methods.name: addProductImageDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a product image and updates the entity.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a product image in the specified size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image by store code, product code, filename, and size.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a product.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a product image from storage and deletes its record.
